rationale: This diagnostic-item function is erased during VIR conversion and replaced by an OpenInvariant block, whose verifier semantics establish the invariant value and enforce restoration. An ordinary function postcondition would not model or survive that transformation.
risks: Adding `_inv.inv(result.1)` would expose only the opening fact while omitting the mandatory paired close and atomicity protocol.
No public specification vocabulary relates `InvariantBlockGuard` to the verifier-managed open invariant state.
